Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı suprapatellar reseste daha belirgin olmak üzere orta derecede artmış. Diz eklemindeki trikompartmantal dejeneratif eklem hastalığı medyal femorotibyal eklem yüzeylerinde belirgin olup patellanın apeksi ve medyal fasetindeki yüzeyel kondral düzensizlikler ve milimetrik kondral fissürler, medyal femoral kondilin ağırlık taşıyan yüzeyinin posteriyorundaki yer yer fokal olarak tam kata ulaşan milimetrik kondral kayıplar ve milimetrik marjinal osteofitler ile karakterize. Lateral menisküs normal. Çapraz ve yan bağlar bunların dışında normal. Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Pain for 3 days. Ski accident.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Osseous contusion along the peripheral aspect of the lateral femoral condyle and along the medial aspect of the patella consistent with a recent transient patellar dislocation. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Large joint hemarthrosis with intra-articular clot in the suprapatellar joint recess.  No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Complete tear of the MPFL from the adductor tubercle. High-grade sprain of the medial patellar retinaculum at the patellar attachment.
Patellofemoral tracking: Lateral patellar tilt and translation. Borderline patella alta. Oblique morphology of the trochlea. Increased tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 25 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Findings of a recent transient lateral patellar dislocation with osseous contusions, large knee joint hemarthrosis, and injuries of the medial patellofemoral ligament and patellar retinacula, as described above.
2.	Anatomic morphology predisposing to patellofemoral maltracking, as described above.
